split_strategy: Positives ask for resellers (distributor, wholesaler, dealer, trading company) in a country. Negatives: consumer store locators, freight forwarders, hiring agents.
passing_rule: should_trigger=true -> trigger_rate > 0.5 over N runs. should_trigger=false -> trigger_rate <= 0.5.
